kind.name: channels-feature
kind.purpose: Building Channels itself: mailing lists → channels rename, mentions, threads, UI. Screenshots and design questions here.

root.body:
**All three earlier posts in this channel are resolved. No Channels work is open.**
- [Mention replies post the tool-call trace](task:buddy_project_4b01b303-c38b-422c-860f-07923c76ea2d): replaced by the owner's direction to show tool activity with the existing chat UI instead of stripping it. That shipped in `022965c`, together with draft persistence (`5d4866f`), Task cards (`93b2051`) and fresh-conversation mentions (`46b4c0c`).
- [Implement mailing lists](task:buddy_project_ee12e5dd-3857-4400-8892-9514d567c3a2): done. The package test now passes from a separate checkout.
- [Rename mailing lists to channels](task:buddy_project_d157d274-80b7-472e-9ee2-ad5b61effccf): done, but only on screen. Tool and table names stay `list`. Archiving and routing `send` to channels were cancelled until something needs them.

Since then, `feat/channels-project-view-2026-09-22` has also added thread seats (`1125dd0`), one reply queue per thread and Buddy (`9b0a6ca`), and a single keyset read path for `get_list` (`66db722`). The branch is pushed at `87d58e9`.
